_comment: Sample PREIshare listings for semantic search. Fields match public.properties: id (uuid), title, description, city, status. owner_id and embedding are set by scripts/seed-property-embeddings.ts. Do not add price, bedrooms, or state — those columns are not on this table.

properties.title: Lakefront lodge
properties.description: Peaceful stay with strong weekend occupancy. Pine trees wrap the deck; guests book Friday through Sunday for a quiet getaway with reliable short-stay income. No highway rumble. Kayaks sit by the dock.

properties.title: Woodland retreat on the shore
properties.description: Rustic cottage with a dock and a fire pit. Investors chase summer occupancy and autumn leaf-season demand. Birds, not bars, set the soundtrack.

properties.title: Bright loft above the music halls
properties.description: Open-plan unit over late-night venues and busy kitchens. Transit and offices are a short walk. Built for young professionals who want city energy, not a silent woods weekend.

properties.title: Center-city loft steps from cafes
properties.description: Sixth-floor unit in the core, with espresso bars and dinner spots along the sidewalk. Designed for people who live on foot among shops rather than a car commute to a cul-de-sac.

properties.title: Four-bedroom house on a quiet cul-de-sac
properties.description: Yard for kids, a driveway for two cars, and an elementary campus three blocks away. Long-term tenant demand from households, not a vacation-rental play.

properties.title: Mid-block duplex with weekday occupancy
properties.description: Two units near a hospital campus. Travel nurses and contract staff keep beds filled year-round. Spreadsheets, not sunsets, are the pitch.

properties.title: Large agricultural acreage for row crops
properties.description: Tillable fields sized for corn and soybeans, with a grain bin and tractor shed. This is working farmland, not a lifestyle stay and not a walkable city home.

properties.title: Industrial warehouse with loading dock
properties.description: High ceilings, truck bays, and a fenced yard for pallets. Built for logistics, not families, nightlife, or a quiet lodge weekend.
